title: GLobal Urban Soil Ecology Education Network
description: A collaborative research project tackling soil ecology. The microbial portion of this study aims to understand how land use in urbanization controls the assembly of microbial communities. We test the Biotic Homogenization hypothesis and whether convergence is occurring among globally dispersed urban areas.
